comparison: Both evaluate claims C25-C29 about dILP3 as ISN neurotransmitter. OpenEval finds the RNAi screen and behavioral data SUPPORTED, while peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN due to concerns about off-target effects with only one RNAi hairpin and request for mutant validation.

Both evaluate claims C3, C42-C44 about BiT behavioral experiments. Both find the evidence SUPPORTED, with OpenEval noting opposite phenotypes from gain/loss-of-function and peer reviewers describing experiments as 'convincing' and 'rigorous.'

Both evaluate claims C5, C52, C89 about IPC behavioral effects. Both find SUPPORTED, with OpenEval noting context-dependency and peer reviewers praising authors for addressing literature discrepancies rather than ignoring them.

Both evaluate claims C6, C58-C59 about CCHa2R-RA neurons' selective role in water ingestion. Both find SUPPORTED, with OpenEval highlighting specificity from gain/loss-of-function and peer reviewers praising dissociation of peptidergic circuits.

Both evaluate CCAP neuron behavioral data (C5, C62-C64, C87). Both find SUPPORTED, with OpenEval noting bidirectional regulation and peer reviewers praising characterization of peptidergic circuits including CCAP.

Both evaluate connectome analysis claims (C2, C36-C39 in OpenEval; adds C71-C72 in peer review). Both find SUPPORTED, with OpenEval highlighting quantitative synaptic data and peer reviewers praising 'state-of-the-art methodology' and anatomical reconstruction.

OpenEval evaluates C40-C41 (ISN→BiT voltage imaging) as SUPPORTED. Peer review evaluates C40-C41 plus C49, C80 (IPC imaging) as UNCERTAIN due to methodological concerns about voltage vs calcium sensor choices without explanation.

OpenEval evaluates C49, C80 (BiT→IPC functional imaging) as SUPPORTED. Peer review groups these with C40-C41 and rates UNCERTAIN due to general methodological concerns about sensor choice rationale throughout the paper.

Both evaluate functional imaging of CCAP neurons (C60, C79). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED based on reproducible activation data. Peer review rates UNCERTAIN due to methodological concerns about voltage vs calcium sensor choices.

Both evaluate CCHa2R-RA connectivity and activation (C54-C57 in OpenEval; C56-C57, C60, C79 in peer review). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED; peer review rates UNCERTAIN due to methodological concerns about sensor choices.

Both evaluate main conclusions about ISN peptidergic network (C1, C67-C70, C92 in OpenEval; C7, C67, C69-C70, C85, C92 in peer review). Both find SUPPORTED, with OpenEval noting comprehensive evidence integration and peer reviewers calling findings 'significant and convincing' while noting future work needed on circuit interactions.

OpenEval evaluates C45-C48 (BiT→IPC connectivity) as SUPPORTED. Peer review R10 evaluates broader connectome claims (C1, C4, C45-C48, C54-C55, C65-C66) as SUPPORTED, praising comprehensive anatomical reconstruction.

OpenEval evaluates C65-C66 (weak ISN→CCAP connectivity) as SUPPORTED. Peer review R10 groups this with broader connectome analysis (C1, C4, C45-C48, C54-C55, C65-C66) and finds SUPPORTED, praising anatomical work.

OpenEval evaluates C71-C74 (ISN postsynaptic partner distribution) as SUPPORTED. Peer review R2 evaluates C2, C36-C39, C71-C72 as SUPPORTED, praising anatomical reconstruction without specific mention of C73-C74.

OpenEval evaluates C85-C86 (peptidergic integration) as SUPPORTED. Peer review R9 evaluates broader conclusions including C85 as SUPPORTED, noting future work needed on circuit interactions but not challenging the integration concept.
OpenEval evaluates C75-C77 (dILP3 functional role interpretation) as SUPPORTED based on integration of current and prior work. No corresponding peer review evaluation found.
